title: Pick the larger of two numbers
objective: Write a function that compares two numbers with if and gives back the larger one.

body.text: A function can compare its inputs and give back the one it needs. Put the case you want first inside an if, and give back the other value after it. The first gives back that runs ends the function.

body.title: The larger number
body.code:
function larger
    takes number called a
    takes number called b
    returns a number
    if a is greater than b
        gives back a
    gives back b

say larger 3 and 8
say larger 10 and 2

body.prompt: larger 3 and 8 prints 3 because the function never compares its inputs. Make it print 8.
body.starter:
